experiment: M7R: a new prospective experiment, distinct from M7 and M7b. M7 and M7b remain recorded as failed under their own frozen rules; their results support this hypothesis only and pass nothing retroactively.
decision: Owner decision relayed 2026-10-30: re-test reusable descriptor pools under a complete-operation contract that counts teardown.
mechanism: Dispatch descriptor sets are allocated from context-owned FREE_DESCRIPTOR_SET pool blocks (256 sets, 1024 descriptors per type) and freed at use release, instead of vkCreateDescriptorPool/vkDestroyDescriptorPool per dispatch use per submission (the original M7 source, rebased onto 1823497b5)
codeComparison: Counting-layer measurement, steady state per vector iteration: Doe main does 1 vkCreateDescriptorPool + 1 vkDestroyDescriptorPool + 1 vkAllocateDescriptorSets + 1 vkUpdateDescriptorSets; M7R does 1 allocate + 1 free + 1 update; Dawn does none because its sets are made at bind group creation
teardownAttribution: A locked per-call teardown diagnostic on image put the M7 excess in the first buffer release (25 -> 55 us; it retires the final recording and frees its sets) and in device release (273 -> 313 us; destroys the block). Isolated microprobes time each call under 10 us, so the cause remains unexplained; teardown is counted in the gate below instead of excluded.

sampling.inputs: c1 frozen inputs and independent oracles

metric: complete = compileNs + pipelineNs + resourcesNs + sum of every iteration's operation interval + teardownNs (CPU oracle excluded; setup, which M7R does not touch, excluded). Ratios are m7r/main per balanced pair; bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029.

acceptance.validity: every process ok and oracle-checked on every iteration; A/A dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median within [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1 on every workload
acceptance.dispatchWorkloads: vector and image: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 AND warm.submit CI95 upper < 1.0
acceptance.uploadReadbackBound: buffer_upload_readback_exact_1mb (no dispatch; not excluded): complete CI95 upper <= 1.02
acceptance.phaseGuard: no warm phase on any workload with ratio CI95 lower > 1.05; teardownNs and first.operation are recorded and are already inside complete
acceptance.verdict: pass only if validity, dispatchWorkloads, uploadReadbackBound and phaseGuard all hold

focusedCorrectness: pre-freeze, untimed: all 78 physical native clients identical to the main control (only 'failures' fails, on main too); native software check, check-vulkan and Vulkan backend contracts compared with main (results recorded beside this contract)

correctnessResults.nativeSoftwareCheck: 90 PASS before the failures abort, identical to main; 44 later clients failing only sample-mask and d3d12-buffer-placement, identical to main
correctnessResults.vulkanContracts: failing only surface_features and feature_contract, identical to main
